title: Overnight Codex replay rows use the discounted background completion window
body:
Operator-pasted note 2026-11-17 (unverified; source: OpenAI API changelog, background mode): Responses API background_options.completion_window gives 30% (2 h) or 40% (8 h) off model tokens, including follow-up tool-call requests. Relevant to night grading and the Codex/Sol replay arm (t-188gftz).
Files: src/harness/codex.ts
Outcome: the Codex/Sol replay arm can run overnight rows with completion_window, and rows record the discounted cost; a check confirms the field and prices against OpenAI's own docs first.
Proof: a recorded overnight row shows completion_window and a cost matching the discounted rate.
